NONE: › If two people, especially a man and woman who are not married, cohabit, they live together and have a sexual relationship.
（尤指未婚男女）同居

example: About 23 percent of men and women aged 25 to 34 told researchers they had previously cohabited with a partner without it leading to marriage.
年齡在25至34歲之間的男女中約有23%的人告訴研究人員，他們有過同居而最終沒有結婚的經歷。
cohabiting couples
同居伴侶

NONE: › the official word for someone who lives in the same house, apartment, etc. as someone else
同住者；同居者

example: Is Mr Jones one of the cohabitants at this address?
瓊斯先生是住在這個地址的人之一嗎？

NONE: › If an argument or theory coheres, all the different stages fit together to form a reasonable whole.
（論據或理論）連貫，有條理
› to unite or to hold together as a unit
使結合為一體；凝結；黏和

example: His vision is of a world that coheres through human connection rather than rules.
他構想中的世界是透過人際關係而非規章制度連繫在一起的。

NONE: C2 the situation when the parts of something fit together in a natural or reasonable way
連貫性，一致性

example: There was no coherence between the first and the second half of the movie.
該影片的前半部分和後半部分之間缺乏連貫性。

NONE: C2 If an argument, set of ideas, or a plan is coherent, it is clear and carefully considered, and each part of it connects or follows in a natural or reasonable way.
（論據、觀點、計劃）有條理的，連貫的，前後一致的
C2 If someone is coherent, you can understand what that person says.
（講話）條理清晰的，清楚明白的

example: When she calmed down, she was more coherent (= able to speak clearly and be understood).
她冷靜下來後，講話有條理多了。

NONE: › the situation when the members of a group or society are united
凝聚（力）；團結

example: social/national cohesion
社會／國家凝聚力
The lack of cohesion within the party lost them votes in the election.
黨內缺乏凝聚力使他們在選舉中失去了選票。

NONE: › united and working together effectively
有凝聚力的；團結的

example: a cohesive group
有凝聚力的團體

NONE: › specialized social science a group of people who share a characteristic, usually age
有共同特點（通常指年齡）的一群人
› disapproving a group of people who support a particular person, usually a leader
（通常指領袖的）追隨者，支持者；黨羽

example: This study followed up a cohort of 386 patients aged 65+ for six months after their discharge home.
這項研究對386位年齡在65歲以上、出院回家的患者進行了六個月的跟蹤觀察。
The Mayor and his cohorts have abused their positions of power.
市長和他的同黨濫用職權。
